description: Turn a task into an executable plan before you spend anything: the steps in the order they should run, what each step costs, what would fail, and every field you have to supply first. Free, and it never invokes anything.

budget_usd.description: The most you are willing to spend, in USD.

capabilities_required.description: The capabilities you need. When you give this list it IS the requirement set.

limit.description: How many matches to plan around. Maximum 25.

task.description: What you want to do, in your own words.

name: plan_preflight

caller_must_supply.description: Every field the caller has to provide, with the step it belongs to.

discovery.description: The full discovery answer this plan was built from — the same shape the discover tool returns.

executable.description: True when the plan can be run as it stands.

not_executable_reason.description: Why the plan cannot be run, when it cannot.

step_count.description: How many steps the plan has.

catalogue_text.description: The catalogue's own words for this service, inside a delimited data field.

http_route.description: The route to call it on.

mcp_tool_name.description: The MCP tool that does the same thing.

required_input_types.description: The type of each required field.

would_fail.description: What would go wrong with this step.

total_cost_basis.description: Which services the total is the sum of.

total_cost_reason.description: Why the total is what it is.

total_cost_usd.description: What the whole plan costs, or null when it cannot be known. Never an estimate.

what_would_fail.description: Everything that would stop this plan from completing.

title: Plan Preflight
